sql:
SELECT
  s.period,
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  SUM(s.qty) AS qty
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.channel = 'wholesale'
  AND s.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY s.period, c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY s.period, qty DESC
